text: Which AI automation consultants in Newcastle specialise in Microsoft Copilot Studio, AI agents, and practical AI workflow automation for mid-market businesses?

sections.text:

- **Dynamic Business Technologies** — Offers business-led AI consulting across Microsoft Copilot, AI agents, workflow automation, generative AI, and business-systems integration. Its approach starts with identifying the operational problem before selecting Copilot, automation, or an agent.[4]
- **Flowtivity** — Provides Newcastle AI consulting, custom AI agents, and intelligent workflow automation, with an emphasis on practical implementation for sectors including mining, healthcare, education, and manufacturing.[5]

For **Microsoft Copilot Studio specifically**, the clearest specialist is:

- **Marra** — Based at Newcastle Helix, it explicitly delivers Copilot Studio agent development, Microsoft 365 Copilot enablement, Power Platform integrations, workflow automation, readiness assessments, governance, and deployment across internal and customer-facing use cases.[1][2]
